name: 89029 · Laughlin, NV
findings: ZIP 89029 (Laughlin) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89029 (Laughlin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
